welcome.title: Three-finger pinches
welcome.text: Windows will appear in front of you. Do what each one asks, as you would on a real one: they don't move or click, the cameras record your hands.|Press the button on the right side of the headset to start each step. Pressed while recording, it pauses.

done.title: All done
done.text: Thank you! This recording session will close. Continue in the application.|Review your recordings in the Hand recorder window.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.text: What was recorded so far is saved. Review it in the Hand recorder window.

sections.title: Hand size
sections.intro: First, your hand size: both hands up about 40 cm out, still.

prompts.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Palms toward you

switch.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Backs toward you

sections.title: Three-finger pinches
sections.intro: Pinches with three fingers: the thumb on the index and middle fingertips together, as for scrolling, mixed with ordinary taps so the tracker learns to tell them apart. Nothing happens when you do: the cameras record your hand.

prompts.text: Right hand raised and pointing. Purple 3: a three-finger tap, the thumb on the index and middle|fingertips together. Cyan: thumb to index only. Orange with a cross: stop about 1 cm short.
Left hand pointing. Purple 3: three-finger tap. Cyan: thumb to index only.
Right hand pointing at the lit row. Pinch with three fingers, move the hand down about 10 cm|as if scrolling the list, then let go. Open the fingers clearly after each.
Left hand: three-finger pinch on the lit row, move the hand down as if scrolling, let go.
Right hand pointing. Each button says which: cyan, thumb to index; purple, thumb to middle;|purple 3, thumb to both together.
Left hand: the same three. Cyan index, purple middle, purple 3 both.
Right hand low by your lap, palm down, as with gaze: look at the lit button and tap there.|Purple 3: three fingers. Cyan: thumb to index.
Both hands up and pointing. Each lit button says L or R: a three-finger tap with that hand.
Your own pace: three-finger pinches, taps and scrolls on the list, as you like.|Move the arm while you do: straight, bent, higher and lower.
